batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c AD Mathews b Z Khan

batting.name: M Vohra
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b Z Khan

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b NM Coulter-Nile

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c SS Tiwary b NM Coulter-Nile

batting.name: NLTC Perera
batting.dismissal: c SS Tiwary b NM Coulter-Nile

batting.name: AR Patel
batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b NM Coulter-Nile

batting.name: SS Iyer
batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b SN Thakur

balls.text: slammed over deep midwicket for six. A good old slog that was. Got down on one knee and mowed it powerfully
he's hit that towards long on for a single

Yuvraj has dropped an absolute sitter at point. Thakur reached out for a wide ball and sliced it tamely towards point. All Yuvraj had to do was take a few steps back and catch it but it popped out. Some fielders may have caught that with actually buttered fingers
played through cover for a single
short ball, Thakur goes back to hit through midwicket but cannot connect
a low full toss on the pads, the batsman tries to flick through midwicket but gets a leading edge through cover instead
a fast full toss and Tahkur gets an inside edge that takes the ball past the keeper for four streaky runs
Thakur swings and misses a good length ball

Miller's gone too. It's been a sorry start for KXIP and it's a sorry finish. Coulter-Nile bowled the ball full and wide outside off stump, not letting Miller hit to his favoured leg side. Miller reached out for the ball, got under it and played a lofted drive straight to the fielder on the cover boundary. Coulter-Nile has four wickets
in the blockhole again, Patel digs it out towards square leg for a single
speared in full and fast from round the wicket, Miller tries to heave on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pad, the ball bounces away to the off side

holes out to long-on! Patel was on the front foot as he tried to flat-bat a short of a length delivery from Coulter-Nile, the angle from round the wicket denied him the room too. He hit it straight to Agarwal
a very low full toss on middle stump, Patel drives through cover, only a single and Miller won't have the strike
in the blockhole again, Miller stays in his crease and hits the ball to long on, top over from Mathews, superb lengths
the slower short ball, Patel charges and then mis-times the pull towards midwicket, he would have been run out had there been a direct hit at the bowler's end
no room to work with, Patel steps out and cuts the ball to point, he wanted to play it cover cover
in the blockhole and Miller can only hit it to long on for a single
plays a full toss straight to midwicket where the fielder collects and hits the stumps direct at the striker's end, they run an overthrow
short ball and it is pulled towards deep midwicket
in the blockhole but there's width outside off, Miller jams his bat down and sends the ball racing towards short third man, where Coulter-Nile dives to his right to save a boundary
Patel steps out of his crease and hits a short of a length ball past the diving fielder at cover
a low full toss, nearly in the blockhole, Miller digs it out on the off side and they chance a risky single. The fielder should have thrown at Miller's end
Zaheer bowls a cutter on a good length outside off, Miller waits and cuts hard, he makes good contact but doesn't beat point
a length ball outside off, cut off the back foot to deep backward point
played on the leg side for a single
Patel steps forward and across his stumps to nudge on the leg side but gets beaten by a legbreak from Tahir that spins down leg side, the ball beats the keeper too for five wides
played off the back foot through midwicket
bowled extremely wide outside off, to deny Miller the space to hit towards leg, Miller reaches for it and drives hard, but can't beat Zaheer at cover
full toss, and Miller smashes it along the ground this time to the cow-corner boundary
Miller attacks Tahir this time, stepping out of his crease and swinging hard, he hits the ball far over the wide long-on boundary
nudged off the pads through square leg for a single
ends the over with a yorker that Miller plays back to the bowler
Miller tries to drive but gets an outside edge to short third man, reaches the fielder on the bounce. Mathews bowled that much fuller
Miller's cutting loose, he steps out again, makes room by moving outside leg and then frees his arms, slapping the ball high over cover and into the gap in the outfield
Patel steps out and drives a length ball to long on for a single
the slower ball, dabbed on the off side for a single
a low full toss, Miller steps out to make it one actually, and then he drills it flat and powerfully over the infield at cover
shot! Patel steps out of his crease to get to the pitch of the googly and lofts it dead straight, hitting cleanly for the first six of the match. About time too, the Daredevils will say
a googly outside off stump, defended on the off side
steps out and drives the ball to wide long on for one more
played off the back foot but to cover
Miller tries to sweep from wide outside off but is beaten by the googly
drags it down short and gets pulled behind square for a single
a length ball around off, Patel drives through cover for a single to keep the strike
Miller steps out and Mathews gives him a short one, cramping him for room. Miller manages to swat on the leg side
full ball outside off and it shoots through, beating Miller, who is really fortunate the line wasn't straighter. That kept extremely low.

short of a length and Patel is late on the pull, he gets a bottom edge into his body and Miller calls him through for a single once the ball rolls on the off side. The fielder rushing in from cover doesn't pick up cleanly
once again he manages only to push the ball tamely into the covers
good length on middle and off, Patel defends on the off side, he needs to give the strike to Miller
a length ball down leg side, Patel tries to pull but the ball is too far away
driven down the ground for a single
nudged off the pads on the leg side

Mishra bowls the googly and beats an attempt at a flamboyant drive from Patel. There was a thick edge that bounced off the keeper's gloves. Would have been a terrific catch because the deviation was significant
Miller gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball from outside off towards deep square leg
closes the face too early and he gets a leading edge that lobs up safely on the off side
hit towards long on for a single to Miller
driven on the front foot to short cover
worked off the pads towards square leg for one more
stays in his crease and hits the ball through point
fired it quick outside off, the ball keeps low and beats the bat
Miller gets outside the line of off and tries to sweep but doesn't connect
nudged off the pads behind square for a single
a full ball outside off, Patel strides forward and drives smoothly to wide mid off

pulled away, and he's been caught at deep square leg! Coulter-Nile went round the wicket and angled the ball into Perera, pitching it short of a length. Perera pulled, hitting the ball hard but flat. Saurabh Tiwary came running in from the boundary and slid, getting his hands under the ball as it was dying on him while continuing to slide. That's a smart catch.
Miller moves forward and towards the off side to nudge a length ball off his thigh towards fine leg
full and straight, Perera backs away towards leg and slogs, he gets an inside edge that goes towards fine leg
good length and slanting across the left hander, Perera swivels and tries to swat but gets beaten again
short of a length and climbing across the left-hander with pace and bounce, Perera stays in his crease and fends at the ball as it whizzes past his shoulder
fired flat and fast and into the pads, tucked behind square for a single
swept behind square for another single
punched off the back foot through midwicket for one more
Perera winds up and slaps the ball firmly through cover point to get off the mark
Duminy dives to his right to cut off a Perera straight drive
Duminy pitches around off from round the wicket and gets the ball to spin away from Miller, who manages to hit the ball to long on

lbw! Mishra slowed his pace and drifted the ball on to leg and middle and got it to turn towards off. Bailey moved his front foot across to sweep but played too early and was hit on the pad. That looked pretty good
tossed up on off stump, Bailey stays in his crease and drives to cover
played towards long on for a single
he tries to sweep again but fails to connect, gets hit on the pad
Miller connects with the sweep this time, getting low and hitting the ball from leg and middle hard, beats the fielder on the square leg boundary
bowled fast-ish and full outside off, Bailey gets on the front foot and drives to long off
Bailey gives long on work to do with another hit along the ground in that direction
punched off the back foot through cover point
Miller tries to sweep powerfully but is beaten outside off stump
Bailey steps out and hits the ball towards wide long on
played on the leg side for one, Miller is away, slowly
big appeal for lbw as Miller moves back and across outside off to hit on the leg side and is struck on the pad, that was outside the line of off stump

Bailey flicks the ball off his pads towards long leg and Zaheer - as well as he has bowled today - isn't the most nimble in the field. He doesn't get down quickly enough to stop what more athletic fielders might have
Miller moves across a little again and this time he gets hit on the pad, Coulter-Nile appeals but that was missing leg by a long way
a wide called, a bit harsh in my opinion because Miller had moved a long way across his stumps to glance the ball as it sped past his hip
stays in his crease this time and opens the face to run the ball off it towards third man
a fuller and straighter ball and Bailey leans on to the front foot to drive towards mid-off, nicely timed but can't beat the fielder
short and wide outside off, a hit-me-please ball, and Bailey frees his arms and cuts it hard over point
good length on off stump, Bailey gets behind the line and defends on the leg side
Miller moves forward and across and closes the face of the bat to turn a length ball off his pads towards the leg side, there's a catcher at short midwicket and the ball falls short of him
good length outside off stump, Miller moves forward smoothly and punches the ball into the covers, he hit that well
steered to third man for one more
pushed from the crease towards point
slants the ball into the right hander from round the wicket, good length on off and middle, Bailey stays in his crease and defends on the off side
Bailey moves across his crease and nudges a length ball off his hips through square leg, just a gentle tap but his timing was great
Miller moves across his stumps to play a good length delivery towards square leg
pushed on the off side for a single
good length on off and middle, Bailey gets behind the line and blocks

this is a procession. Meek and embarrassing. Saha pokes at one from his crease with no footwork and edges it, Jadhav stoops low and to his right to catch it. Good length on a tight line outside off from the bowler, nothing extraordinary though
defended on the off side
Coulter-Nile bowls a good length outside off, keeps a touch low and beats the bat

this is some comeback from Zaheer! He's blown two huge holes in the Kings XI hull. Vohra moved forward and outside leg to try and make room but ended up being cramped by Zaheer's good length ball. It bounced a bit more as well. Vohra tried to dab at it awkwardly and only managed to edge it through to the keeper
good length on off stump, Vohra stays in his crease and opens the face to play the ball to point
slower ball? The bounce just died on Vohra as the ball angled across him from over the wicket. He was beaten
steered from the crease towards third man for a single
some zip off the surface from Zaheer and the ball bounces on Saha who stayed in his crease and took one hand off the bat as he tried to defend
good length and line, Saha gets into a tangle as he tries to play on the leg side
width offered outside off stump but the batsman can't beat point with the cut
pushed off the back foot through wide mid-on
played through midwicket for a single
defended on the front foot
nudged off the front foot through midwicket

He's struck first ball! Marsh has been given lbw. Duminy fired the ball full and angling into the left-hand batsman from round the wicket, Marsh was caught on his crease and struck in front as he played across the line. That looked pretty adjacent. The umpire took a while to raise his finger and before he did the fielder at slip - Yuvraj - had collected the ball and broken the stumps at the striker's end. So there was an appeal for a run out too, but Marsh was then given lbw. Replays show that the ball might have been clipping leg stump, but Marsh would have been given run out had he not been given lbw
left alone by Vohra, who's been watching the action from the other end
dabbed to third man from the crease, the ball races across this quick outfield
defended awkwardly on the leg side
Zaheer gets the ball to swing away from the left-hander Marsh but the movement ends up giving Marsh a lot of width, the length is full as well and so Marsh square drives to the point boundary

caught at point! Zaheer strikes second ball on his comeback. The length was good and the line closer to off stump, Sehwag pushed forward and firmly and the ball flew off the outside edge towards the fielder at point, who was standing rather close. Mathews took it well

a length ball outside off stump, there's width but the ball grips on the pitch and comes slower than Sehwag expected. He played the drive too early and ended up spooning the ball over cover point, in the air but safe. They ran two but the umpire has called one short
sprays it wide outside off and that's the end of the game
Tiwary steps out and hoists the ball off his pads with a muscular short-arm swing, levels the scores with a one-bounce four to deep midwicket
worked off the pads through square for another single
cut off the back foot but can't beat point, point beats himself though by throwing and conceding an overthrow
goes back and across to defend towards the bowler
defended on the front foot as the ball turns into him, that actually missed the bat and hit the pad
lots of width outside off and Agarwal uses his fast hands to play a checked cut shot, he's hit it well enough to beat point, he too gets to his half-century
the short of a length delivery gets big on Agarwal, who is beaten as he tries to dab the ball
a length ball on the pads, glanced to fine leg

caught at deep midwicket! Iyer moves across his crease and chips a length ball off his pads, it lands in the hands of Patel, who came running in from the boundary to take a simple catch. That's Thakur's first IPL wicket and it's come after considerable punishment. Iyer seemed to play too early
full delivery wide outside off stump, Agarwal reaches for it and square drives to deep point
Agarwal moves across his stumps to a really short ball and pulls the ball towards deep midwicket, he had so much time to play that shot so he could pick out the gap on the boundary
played to third man for a single
that could have been a wicket! The ball was short and Agarwal pulled it really hard, but it was in the air as it burst through Bailey's hands and raced to the boundary to bring up the 100 partnership
a length ball outside off, driven powerfully on the back foot but the fielder in cover intercepts the shot
short of a length on leg stump, Iyer stays in his crease and swats the ball towards square leg, two fielders converge on it but neither dive to try and save the boundary. Iyer gets to his fifty
opens the face late to steer the ball and give third man a chase to his right
nudged off the front foot through midwicket
nearly in the blockhole and the batsman can only dig it down the ground
punched off the front foot to cover, but it's a no ball, and there's a free hit coming up. That's a harsh call for no-ball, a bit of the heel was behind the line
wide ball outside off stump, Agarwal slashes and is beaten, there was some deviation but it's late swing I think
the slower ball but that's so far down leg side
full ball on off stump, driven along the ground to long off for a single
short of a length and wide outside off, Iyer might have known third man was wide so he dabs the ball late and fine enough to beat the fielder
too full outside off, Iyer moves forward and drives through the line, lofting the ball on the up over wide mid-off for another boundary
played with an open face towards third man
that's a tremendous hit! Iyer uses his reach and frees his arms, an unrestrained and full swing sending the ball deep into the stands at deep midwicket
Agarwal dabs the ball with deft hands towards point and runs
short ball, the batsman gets squared up and flat-bat slaps the ball past the diving bowler
another push down the ground for one
swings hard across the line but mis-times the ball along the ground through square leg, he was aiming towards midwicket
played off the back foot towards long on for another easy single
moves forward and across to nudge one off his pads behind square
a full ball wide outside off, driven on the front foot but to cover
too wide outside off, Agarwal reaches for it again and this time makes crisp contact with the cut shot, beating the third man fielder
Agarwal chases a wide one, there's an appeal for caught behind but it's a ploy to distract the umpire, it fails
Iyer mis-times a heave but the ball falls safely in the extra cover region, the short of a length ball outside off seemed to get big on him
stays in his crease and steers the ball to third man
a length ball with width outside off, Iyer chips it over the infield with a cover drive
dabbed from the crease to short third man
bowled very slowly but the line is on the pads, the batsman uses the angle into him from round the wicket to nudge behind square
Agarwal leans forward and across to nudge a full ball off his pads behind square
bowled slower on middle stump, Iyer stays in his crease and drives to long on
driven off the front foot to long off for a single
that's a long hop and Iyer moves back and across towards the off to heave towards long leg
good length and straight, driven to long on for a single
short of a length wider outside off, Agarwal dabs it down to third man for a single
too short, and on leg stump, Agarwal gets inside the line and pulls to the backward square leg boundary
short of a length and straight, Iyer drops the ball close on the off side and sprints through for a single, excellent initiative from Agarwal at the non-striker's
another steer off the back foot to third man for one more
good length on off, the batsman stays back and opens the face to guide the ball to third man
short of a length outside off, Iyer pulls towards square leg for a single
Sandeep swings the ball into the blockhole, the batsman waits and digs it out towards midwicket
punched off the front foot towards cover, a direct hit at the striker's end allows an overthrow off the ricochet
that kept low and hit Iyer on the pad as he tried to hit through the leg side, he was deep in his crease but the impact was outside leg
played from the crease to midwicket
poor line, down leg side, Agarwal glances off his pads and beats the fielder at short fine leg to collect four
bowls the yorker on middle stump but Iyer is goo enough to dig it out on the leg side
swings the ball into the right-hander, the batsman stays in his crease and works the ball through midwicket
worked off the pads towards midwicket, can't find the gap
hits a good length just outside off and nips in to the right-hander, defended on the off side
short ball, Agarwal has the room to free his arms. He pulls and manages to clear the deep midwicket boundary, only just but that will do
good length around off stump, defended on the off side
nudged close on the off side for a quick single
defended on the leg side
slides down leg this time, another one to extras
Iyer slogs at a short of a length ball and ends up swatting it in the air but into no-man's land near the circle at cover point
played on the off side, another dot ball
loses his footing as he tries to flick off the pads and falls to the ground in his crease, no chance of leg bye now
gentle medium swinging in towards middle stump, played off the front foot to midwicket
swings into the pads, Iyer tries to heave big on the leg side but misses, he'll run a leg bye to square leg to keep the strike
width outside off but the pace off the pitch is slower and Iyer mis-times the ball to mid off
worked off the pads towards midwicket
good length on middle and off, Iyer stays in his crease and defends on the leg side
steered off the back foot towards third man
defended on the off side on the front foot

reaches for another wide one and tries to cut, he gets a bottom edge past his stumps towards fine leg, the ball is travelling slow enough for the fielder to collect this time. Thakur's first over in the IPL costs 19
a full ball on the pads, Iyer flicks towards long leg, the fielder dives full length on the boundary but can't make the save
fires it down leg side now, so that first ball is looking like a false dawn
and again! Too short and too wide. Iyer flays at it, using every inch of reach, and slices it over backward point for another six
that's a bad ball, short and really wide, Iyer gets under it and slashes hard, carving the ball over backward point for six
good length, angles into the right-hander, pitches just outside off and seams away, a really good ball. Iyer stays in his crease and shoulders arms, that's a good leave too
short of a length outside off, Iyer tries to cut but is beaten
width outside off and Iyer cuts really hard, Marsh does well to intercept at point but an't prevent the single, saved three runs
Iyer steps forward and then tries to whip the ball through square leg, he gets beaten and hit on the thigh by a skiddy ball that angles into him
the fielder at point dives to his left to cut off the steer, Agarwal is off the mark though
good length on off and middle, Agarwal gets behind the line and defends, the asking rate is now more than run a ball
more swing from a good length at a skiddy pace, defended once again on the front foot towards point
good length and the ball does swing into the right-hander, defended on the front foot towards the off side
